assessment.question: Does Terra critique followed by Sonnet revision improve on plain revision, matched Sonnet self-review and Terra alone?
assessment.finding: Calibration: Sonnet original 5 correct, 3 missing of 8, Sonnet plain revision 5 correct, 3 missing of 8, Terra alone 7 correct, 0 missing of 8. The main review comparison did not run, so no Co-Evolution gain or loss was measured. 2 calibration dispatches failed; see the per-task error receipts. Undispatched dependent work remains missing.
assessment.test_quality: Pinned benchmark sources, container images, prompts, settings and task splits were recorded before calls. Offline valid/invalid fixtures and controller failure tests passed. All stage responses froze before grading; no hidden tests or answer keys reached participants. Response hashes and task-level grader receipts are preserved.
assessment.limitation: This is an eight-task suitability screen with 24 unused reserved tasks, not a full leaderboard submission. One generation per arm limits precision. Missing responses and evaluator errors remain unavailable. A bootstrap interval of zero width on all ties does not prove equivalence. Subscription list-equivalent estimates are not bills; unavailable token records prevent a complete cost total. Generated tasks are a custom public-framework subset. Countdown success additionally requires an exact rational expression using only allowed operators and each number once; this stricter check is disclosed separately from upstream reward.
assessment.decision: Stop at the predeclared gate because the 24-answer calibration was incomplete or had unusable outcomes; baseline E exceeded the six-of-eight ceiling. No Co-Evolution gain or loss has been measured on this benchmark.
assessment.next_action: Publish this outcome and its limitations. Do not rerun failed or wrong answers or change settings after seeing scores. Consider a separate replication only if the predeclared practical gain and overhead thresholds are met.
